# BORNEXA

> BORNEXA installs EV chargers ("laadpaal", "wallbox", "borne de recharge") and Smappee energy management for homes and businesses in Flemish Brabant (Vlaams-Brabant), the Mechelen and Leuven regions and the Brussels-Capital Region, Belgium. Installations follow the Belgian electrical code (AREI / RGIE) and are inspected by an approved inspection body.

- Legal: BORNEXA, enterprise number / VAT BE 1037.811.908 (KBO/BCE, active since 2026-07-01)
- Base: Boortmeerbeek (3190), Vlaams-Brabant — service-area business, no showroom
- Contact: info@bornexa.be · +32 489 24 77 60 · WhatsApp +32 489 24 77 60
- Website: https://www.bornexa.be (Dutch at the root, French under /fr/)
- Languages: Dutch and French
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/QiRj5R2C65znVz5J7
- Last reviewed: 2026-10-02

## What we install

- Chargers: Tesla Wall Connector, Wallbox (Pulsar Max, Pulsar Plus, Commander 2), Smappee (EV Wall, P1 module, Infinity), Alfen, Easee, Zaptec, BMW Wallbox Professional (bidirectional / V2H).
- Installation of a charger the customer already bought (install-only).
- Dynamic load balancing via the digital meter's P1 port, solar-surplus charging, capacity-tariff (capaciteitstarief) peak limiting.
- Business and fleet chargers, apartment buildings (VME / copropriété), repair and diagnostics of existing chargers (all brands).

## Prices (indicative, VAT included)

- Complete installation (charger + installation): from €1,490 incl. 6% VAT (dwelling older than 10 years).
- Installation of a charger supplied by the customer: from €690.
- The final price depends on the charger, the cable route, the protections needed and the state of the distribution board; every quote follows a written analysis or a site visit.

## Technical facts we are often asked about

- Single-phase 230 V: up to 7.4 kW (32 A).
- Three-phase 3×400 V + N: up to 11 kW (16 A) or 22 kW (32 A), depending on the car's onboard charger.
- Three-phase 3×230 V without neutral (older Belgian networks, frequent in Brussels): a charger only charges single-phase (between two phases), even when connected in three-phase. Maximum power = 230 V × current: 3.7 kW at 16 A, 5.7 kW at 25 A, 7.4 kW at 32 A — never 11 or 22 kW.
- Bidirectional charging (V2H) with the BMW Wallbox Professional requires a single-phase 230 V or a 3×400 V + N connection; it is not possible on 3×230 V without neutral. A bidirectional charger must be notified to the grid operator beforehand.
- Current Tesla Model 3 and Model Y charge at most 11 kW on AC.
- Solar charging is driven by the energy actually injected into the grid (measured at the meter), not by solar production; a home battery is usually charged first.

## Service area

Core area (closest, most installations): Boortmeerbeek, Haacht, Keerbergen, Kampenhout, Zemst, Rotselaar, Tremelo, Bonheiden.
Also: Mechelen, Leuven and the Leuven east side (Herent, Bertem, Kortenberg, Bierbeek), Tervuren, Overijse, Hoeilaart, Meise, Sint-Katelijne-Waver, Wezembeek-Oppem, Kraainem, and the Brussels-Capital Region (19 municipalities).

## Regulatory context (Belgium, 2026)

- No federal tax reduction for private home chargers since 31 August 2024; no Fluvius or Sibelga subsidy for private chargers; Brussels Renolution premiums are suspended and never covered chargers.
- 6% VAT for the supply and installation of a charger at a private dwelling older than 10 years, used mainly as a private home, invoiced to its occupant, with the charger in or on the dwelling (facade, garage, carport, driveway or terrace). A charger in the garden or on a parking space next to the driveway is at 21% (circular 2021/C/113).
- Every new charging circuit requires an AREI / RGIE conformity inspection by an approved inspection body.
- The charging point must be notified to the grid operator (Fluvius in Flanders, Sibelga in Brussels; in Brussels within 30 days since 1 January 2025).
